by

target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [MeasurableSpace V] [BorelSpace V] (f : SchwartzMap V ℂ), ∃ g : SchwartzMap V ℂ, ∀ w : V, g w = ∫ v : V, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ v w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v
